subject: science
concept: Understanding evidence for evolution: fossil record, comparative anatomy, and DNA evidence
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Evidence of Common Ancestry) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares physical bone-structure models across species to identify homologous structures
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a type of evidence (fossil, anatomical, genetic) to what it reveals about evolutionary relationships
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described piece of evidence supports the theory of evolution

misconception_flags: confuses a homologous structure (shared ancestry) with an analogous structure (similar function, different ancestry)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
